hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -E 'git push.*(--force|--force-with-lease|-f )' > /dev/null; then echo 'BLOCKED: git push --force requiere acción manual del usuario. Ejecutarlo directamente si es intencional.'; exit 2; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -E 'git push' > /dev/null; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -E '\b(main|master)\b' > /dev/null || [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: push directo a main/master no permitido. Usar un branch y pull request.'; exit 2; fi; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *application.yml ]]; then python3 -c "import yaml, sys; yaml.safe_load(open('$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH'))" 2>&1 || { echo 'BLOCKED: application.yml tiene YAML inválido. La app no arrancará. Revisa la indentación antes de continuar.'; exit 2; }; fi
